This page compiles all peer-reviewed articles, preprints, institutional frameworks, reports, and multimedia lectures cited or used as conceptual inspiration during **Part 1 (Philosophy, Taxonomy & ML Foundations)**. References for **Part 2 (Technical Case Study)** will be added alongside the Session 2 slides.

---

## Core Training & Institutional Frameworks

*   **Blondel, L., Bourel, B., Challand, M., Coux, C., Justeau-Allaire, D., Frelat, R., Marcos, D., Servajean, M., Tieo, S. M., Tresson, P., & Ubilla, P. (2026).** *AI for ecologists: a toolkit for beginners.* An FRB-CESAB training course. <https://ai-ecol.github.io/>
*   **AI4BioMed (2026).** Local seminar/training series mainly organized and promoted by LBBE members, Université Claude Bernard Lyon 1. <https://indico.engineering.univ-lyon1.fr/event/29/>
*   **OECD.AI Policy Observatory.** *OECD Framework for the Classification of AI Systems.* <https://oecd.ai/en/classification>

## Epistemology, Cognition & GenAI Guardrails

*   **Abbosh, A., Al-Anbuky, A., Xue, F., & Mahmoud, S. S. (2025).** Perspective on the Role of AI in Shaping Human Cognitive Development. *Information*, 16(11), 1011. <https://doi.org/10.3390/info16111011>
*   **Barcaui, A. (2025).** ChatGPT as a cognitive crutch: Evidence from a randomized controlled trial on knowledge retention. *Social Sciences & Humanities Open*, 12, 102287. <https://doi.org/10.1016/j.ssaho.2025.102287>
*   **Gerlich, M. (2025).** AI Tools in Society: Impacts on Cognitive Offloading and the Future of Critical Thinking. *Societies*, 15(1), 6. <https://doi.org/10.3390/soc15010006>
*   **Kim, T. W., Usman, U., Garvey, A., & Duhachek, A. (2025).** From algorithm aversion to AI dependence: Deskilling, upskilling, and emerging addictions in the GenAI age. *Consumer Psychology Review*, 9, 142. <https://doi.org/10.1002/arcp.70008>
*   **Kosmyna, N., Hauptmann, E., Yuan, Y. T., Situ, J., Liao, X. H., Beresnitzky, A. V., Braunstein, I., & Maes, P. (2025).** Your brain on ChatGPT: Accumulation of cognitive debt when using an AI assistant for essay writing task. *arXiv preprint*. <https://arxiv.org/abs/2506.08872>
*   **Liu, G., Christian, B., Dumbalska, T., Bakker, M. A., & Dubey, R. (2026).** AI Assistance Reduces Persistence and Hurts Independent Performance. *arXiv preprint*. <https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.04721>
*   **Messeri, L., & Crockett, M. J. (2024).** Artificial intelligence and illusions of understanding in scientific research. *Nature*, 627(8002), 49–58. <https://doi.org/10.1038/s41586-024-07146-0>
*   **Stiegler, B. (2010).** *For a New Critique of Political Economy.* Polity Press.
